sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Customer onboarding requires identity document verification and sanctions list screening before account activation.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons and high-risk jurisdictions.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Alerts must be reviewed within one business day by level-1 analysts.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Escalated cases require level-2 signoff and SAR decision within five business days.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Compliance records must be retained for seven years.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Deletion requests are blocked for records under legal hold or active audit.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: AI outputs for compliance are recommendations and require human approval.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Any override must be documented with rationale and reviewer identity.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Customer complaints involving potential UDAAP risk are triaged in 24 hours.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Root cause analysis must be completed in 10 business days.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Critical vendors require annual control attestation.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Material findings must have remediation plans approved by risk committee.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: EU customer identifiers must remain in EU-hosted systems unless legal basis is approved.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Cross-border transfer requires DPO review and standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Watch list updates occur daily before market open.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Employee trades in restricted securities require pre-clearance.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Sample testing found 6 of 100 alerts exceeded SLA by more than 48 hours.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Remediation required workflow automation and queue balancing.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: 12 percent of files lacked secondary address verification evidence.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Issue owner must close gaps before next quarterly review.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Late SAR decisions were linked to unclear escalation ownership.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Control enhancement added explicit level-2 duty rota.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Lineage for sanctions screening inputs was incomplete in two pipelines.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Engineering committed metadata catalog fixes within 30 days.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Three privileged accounts lacked quarterly recertification evidence.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Temporary exception approved for seven days only.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Analyst notes were missing for 9 percent of AI-assisted cases.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Checklist updated to require evidence citation in every decision.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Institutions must apply risk-based customer due diligence.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Monitoring systems should support timely suspicious activity escalation.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Firms must demonstrate good outcomes for retail customers.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Boards should receive regular outcome metrics and challenge records.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Cross-border personal data transfer requires legal transfer mechanism and risk assessment.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Supervisory authorities may request transfer impact assessments.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Unfair, deceptive, or abusive acts must be prevented through proactive controls.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Complaint trend analysis is expected as an early warning mechanism.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Critical compliance services require tested continuity plans.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Material disruptions must be reported to regulators without undue delay.

sections.title: Scope
sections.text: Automated decision support in regulated functions must remain under accountable human oversight.

sections.title: Control
sections.text: Firms should evidence traceability from recommendation to final decision.
